definition_quote.value: Midwifery means the provision of care, support, and education to healthy women during the childbearing cycle, including normal pregnancy, labor, childbirth, and the postpartum period.
definition_quote.quote: "Midwifery" means the provision of care, support, and education to healthy women during the childbearing cycle, including normal pregnancy, labor, childbirth, and the postpartum period.

methods_authorized.quote: Such care, support, and education may relate to: (A) appropriate measures that promote and maintain the health of the mother and baby; (B) the availability of birthing alternatives; (C) the prevention or reduction of risk to the mother and baby; (D) the detection of abnormal conditions; (E) the procurement of appropriate medical assistance; (F) the execution of emergency measures; (G) the provision of newborn care and appropriate screening; and (H) the provision of wellwoman health care.

drug_authority.value: The Director shall adopt rules defining a protocol and formulary for drug use by licensed midwives, including anti-hemorrhagic drugs and oxygen, subject to approval of the Commissioner of Health.
